user.title: Add PstRotator
user.description: By default this uses PstRotator's own UDP input (port 12000) - no changes needed inside PstRotator itself. Pick Hamlib rotctld or a custom command under Protocol if you'd rather use those.

data.name: Name
data.qth_locator: QTH locator (e.g. JO32wd) — sets the center of the map

error.invalid_qth_locator: Invalid QTH locator. Try something like JO32 or JO32wd.

abort.already_configured: This PstRotator instance is already configured.

data.custom_is_udp: Send custom command over UDP (off = TCP)
data.qth_locator: QTH locator (e.g. JO32wd) — takes priority over the coordinates below
data.home_latitude: Home latitude (optional, instead of a QTH locator)
data.home_longitude: Home longitude (optional, instead of a QTH locator)

storm.title: Storm position
storm.description: Set an azimuth the antenna automatically turns to once wind speed rises above the configured threshold. Leave the wind sensor field empty to disable this.

data.wind_speed_threshold: Wind threshold (same unit as the sensor)

antenna.title: Antenna beamwidth
antenna.description: Draws a transparent triangle on the map showing the antenna's beam. Enter the beamwidth (-3dB) directly, or enter the antenna gain to have the beamwidth calculated automatically (an approximation, not an exact figure for any specific antenna). Gain takes priority if both are set.

data.antenna_gain: Antenna gain (dBi) - calculates the beamwidth automatically

error.invalid_qth_locator: Invalid QTH locator. Try something like JO32 or JO32wd.
